name: Estivant Pines Hike Planner
decision: Should I hike Estivant Pines now, which official loop fits my time, and what weather or seasonal access factors could change the trip?

qualitative: Michigan Nature Association describes Estivant Pines as one of its most popular sanctuaries and maintains two intersecting marked trail loops.
Visit Keweenaw publishes destination guidance for Estivant Pines but no dedicated live trail decision tool was found in the public research pass on 2026-08-25.
The user hiked Estivant Pines in August 2026 and identified a practical gap around current weather, trail choice, access and seasonal conditions.

distinctSearchIntent.reason: A destination-specific live hike decision is not owned by an existing site canonical.

networkFit.reason: Fits Michigan Outdoors / Up North / Keweenaw fall planning; broad tools-page promotion is intentionally deferred while /tools/ is frozen.

uniqueUtility.reason: Combines point weather, alerts, daylight, a weather-based hike read, official route facts and seasonal road context.

authorityAndSeasonFit.reason: Uses MNA as trail authority, NWS for live weather, and Visit Keweenaw for regional access context; useful year-round.

measurementPlan.reason: Launch baseline begins at zero; measure Search Console impressions, CTR and average position for 28 complete days after release, with page visits in Vercel Web Analytics as supporting usage evidence.

cannibalizationSafety.reason: Owns Estivant Pines-specific hiking conditions rather than broad Up North, fall color or Michigan outdoor planning intent.

searchOwnership.primaryIntent: Estivant Pines trail conditions and hike planning

liveData.nationalWeatherService: Direct browser read from api.weather.gov point forecast, alerts and nearest observation station.
liveData.fallColor: Optional seasonal handoff from the site's existing fall-color conditions endpoint.
liveData.trailSensor: None. The page must never describe its weather inference as an inspected or official live trail condition.

measurement.start: First complete day after production release
measurement.supportingUsageMetric: Vercel Web Analytics page visits for /estivant-pines/

namedOutboundClickEvents.reason: Do not claim custom click measurement on the current Vercel Hobby deployment. Add privacy-safe named click events only if the deployed analytics tier supports them later.

measurement.decisionRule: Keep and expand if it earns qualified discovery or repeat utility without cannibalizing broad Up North or fall-color owners. Improve the existing canonical before creating any Estivant keyword variants.

releaseConstraints: Do not touch /tools/ while its active CTR experiment is frozen through 2026-09-21.
Do not change the Keweenaw fall-color destination's protected search-facing treatment merely to promote this tool.
Add broader tool-network promotion only on eligible source surfaces after their measurement windows allow it.
